floor_history.headline: Recon: func_8007B844 identified as PsyQ libgpu ClearOTagR; floor 6 re-confirmed; 2 operand-order forms measured (1 killed, 1 neutral); duplicate axis dead; 3-item frontier banked

frontier.hypothesis: Struct-typed device-table dispatch (`Gpu_dev->otc(ot,n)` via a faithful GpuDevice struct with named fn-ptr fields) changes the post-call pseudo landscape that sched.c sees, unlike the measured-neutral untyped `v0[11]` cast
frontier.mechanism: RTL-gen pseudo allocation at the call boundary feeds RA conflicts and sched.c dependence chains; this is the KNOWN original-source shape (semantically faithful, not a coercion)
frontier.next_probe: Declare the struct (fields to offset 0x2C, otc typed void(*)(u32*,s32)), retype the extern at header level use-site-consistently, dispatch dev->otc(ot,n); sandbox

frontier.hypothesis: BB2_SCHED_DEBUG instrumented cc1 dump on the score-6 form names the exact REG_DEP_TRUE predecessors of the return-staging insn, narrowing the required C dataflow carrier
frontier.mechanism: sched.c INSN_PRIORITY = chain depth to jr; target needs return-staging depth >=4 via the store consuming the return pseudo
frontier.next_probe: cc1 -da/BB2_SCHED_DEBUG on the sandbox .i; dump to tmp/grind/func_8007B844/sN/; enumerate non-copy-prop-foldable store-base carriers

frontier.hypothesis: An existing GCC 2.7.2 PSX decomp has byte-matched libgpu ClearOTagR; its exact C spelling + TU context is the answer
frontier.mechanism: Same compiler family, same library object — a matched cross-project source eliminates the search
frontier.next_probe: Research pass (web/GitHub: SOTN psxsdk tree, psy-q lib decomp repos) for matched ClearOTagR; transcribe and measure each spelling
